title: join_csv
description: Join a csv containing metadata to the .obs or .var field of a mudata file.

input.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `input.h5mu`

modality.description: Which modality from the input MuData file to process.

obs_key.description:
Obs column name where the sample id can be found for each observation to join on.
Useful when adding metadata to concatenated samples.
Mutually exclusive with `--var_key`."

var_key.description:
Var column name where the sample id can be found for each variable to join on.
Mutually exclusive with `--obs_key`."

output.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `output`, example: `output.h5mu`

output_compression.description: The compression format to be used on the output h5mu object.

input_csv.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `metadata.csv`

csv_key.description: column of the the csv that corresponds to the sample id.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
